Admin & Finance

owneradmin
module-rootadmin-financemounted: truenoneAdmin close-out

Owner/admin hub with an overview of cards and a sub-view switcher: lead inbox/qualify, assignment board, close-out queue, payments, price sheets, time-off/blackouts, planning, reports, employees. Buttons: Add Job, Plan, Add Blackout.

Central admin and finance module root for owners and admins to triage leads, assign jobs, close out work, and manage payments, pricing and time off.

Gives owners/admins a one-tap dashboard hub with counts to jump into each admin/finance area of the org.

Review

owneradmin
sub-viewadmin-financemounted: truepaidAdmin close-out

Read-only reconciliation list for owner/admin. A "Needs attention" section shows pending or failed payments. A "Manually confirmed" section groups manual_confirmed payments by the tech who confirmed them. It has no buttons or pickers.

Lets admins spot payments that are stuck or failed and audit payments that techs confirmed manually, before closing out jobs.
